artifact: PHASE 4B §25-§28 - a defined term resolves to its definition or to an approved calculated fact, never to both by accident
precedence: a stable definitionId identifies exactly one definition, and never falls back to a name
a name lookup is scoped to the company and instrument
an evaluable definition beats a supplied value unless the value explicitly names the definition it overrides
overrideField: FinancialInput.overridesDefinitionId - without it, a supplied value that competes with an evaluable definition is a conflict, not a choice
